run_libsize_check: run libsize.py with a .so file and save file to check its size
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare current .so file size against a previously saved size
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py on a new .so file to establish a baseline size in a save file
run_libsize_regression: run libsize.py to detect size regressions in compiled shared library files
run_libsize_debug: run libsize.py to display the file size of a compiled .so for debugging purposes
